archetype: Archetype 2: Performance Pro + Archetype 5: Luxury Hybrid

layout_and_spacing.grid_system: Control Room Grid (gap-4 or gap-6) for dashboards, Tetris Grid for Hero and Map.

surfaces.header: Crystal Glassmorphism: bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-white/10 (Dark Mode).
surfaces.cards: Flat background with 1px subtle border (border-white/10), no soft shadow, sharp edges (rounded-sm or rounded-none).

motion.hover_state: Slight brightness increase, border glow, text color explicit change. hover:bg-zinc-900 hover:text-white
motion.live_indicator: Pulsing red dot with opacity animation (ease-in-out infinite).
motion.page_transitions: Smooth opacity and slight Y-axis translation for immersive feeling.

components.buttons: Shadcn Button customized: uppercase, wide letter spacing, sharp corners (rounded-none or rounded-sm). Primary uses #00E5FF bg with black text.
components.cards: Override default Shadcn card padding to p-6. Apply border-white/10 and flat bg-black.
components.tabs: Shadcn Tabs, transparent list background, use bottom-border active indicator instead of pill.
components.badges: Sharp edges, 1px border. Live match badge uses border-red-500/50 text-red-500 bg-red-500/10.
components.charts: Recharts inside Shadcn Chart container. Use dataviz color palette. No grids or very subtle dotted grid lines.

icons.style: Stroke width 1.5 or 2.0, sharp and technical. Used for data labels, arrows, and nav.

image_urls.description: Cinematic dark stadium lights for home hero.
Aerial stadium view for Interactive Map previews.
Intense player action for Match Center or Story Mode.
Abstract neon nodes for the AI Simulator predictions background.

accessibility_and_testing.test_ids: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='live-match-card').
accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure text over images has dark gradient overlay (e.g., bg-gradient-to-t from-black via-black/60 to-transparent).

instructions_to_main_agent: Theme: Build as a dark-first application. Switch to light mode should respect light_mode_overrides.
Typography: Import and use Cabinet Grotesk (via Fontshare) or Oswald (Google Fonts) for main headings. Use JetBrains Mono for scores, countdowns, and stats data. Manrope for general body.
Hero Section: Must feel cinematic. Use 'hero_background' image with heavy dark gradient overlay. Include big numerical countdown in JetBrains Mono.
Live Ticker: Implement a visual motion pulsing red dot next to a 'LIVE' badge.
Data Visualizations: Use Recharts heavily for radar, heatmaps, and temporal evolution. Strip default axes lines; use the dataviz array for colors.
Flags/Teams: Use standard circular emoji flags or standard SVG initials if exact logos are unavailable. Enclose them in subtle borders.
Layout: Apply 'Control Room' bento grid for Stats and AI Simulator pages. Eliminate empty space, ensure precise alignment.
Overall Vibe: Maintain a high-end, premium feel similar to F1.com or UEFA. Avoid generic SaaS purple gradients; strictly use Obsidian base with Neon Cyan and Crimson Red accents.
